text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before leaving the hotel, I ponder the words I want to say to <chrname> for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The daunting aura of a champion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We must possess that as well.
Even more so if we are to rival those two—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...My right hand is trembling.
I steady it with my left hand and exhale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I panic, <chrname> will pick up on it.
It would only cause her unnecessary anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It's time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Think about what you can do.
After all, you are <chrname>'s
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Longchamp Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Montjeu is going to claim the crown once more!"
"No, this year belongs to Rigantona!"
"Venus Park has evolved too!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crowd surging into the venue
shouts the names of the Umamusume they believe in.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer <username>,
take a deep breath."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
No matter who the opponent is,
<chrname> will be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...That's right!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
Have no fear!
We will become your confidence!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With those words, Chairwoman Akikawa hurriedly spread out a large piece of cloth—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —This is a message for you all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Words of encouragement fill the banner.
'You can do it' 'Run all the way to the end'—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Tracen Academy and the URA collaborated to gather messages of support from all across Japan!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Rally 'round! This flag alone cannot hold it all!
We've received countless words of encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Everyone believes in you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "Never forget! There are people who are captivated by your strength and entrust their hopes to you!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Even if Montjeu and Rigantona were terrifyingly strong—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "To us, you girls are the ones who shine far too brightly!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "To us, you girls are the stars we truly believe can become the best in the world!!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...You're strong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I exhale the air trapped in my lungs.
Breathe out, let it all out, breathe in—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I turn back to face <chrname>.
This is my final major task left before the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
choice_data_list: ...You don't need to feel like you have to win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I don't need thoughts like "What if I lose?" either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During our preparation period up until now,
an appetite for growth was necessary as fuel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, on the world's grandest stage,
even desire itself can sometimes become a distraction to one's focus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swallowing down all my lingering feelings,
I decided to convey it to <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...That was a great send-off, Yayoi.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...I wanted to be of use, too.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Because you've always been the one helping me.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mei. You've chased the dream of becoming the best in the world with me.
Even after I took over for Mother.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This project was something you really wanted to continue with Mother and the others...
Yet you ended up stuck working with me, someone who knows nothing...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I bet old man Symboli and
grandma Mejiro feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
From the past to the future.
...Because there were those who inherited feelings from long ago,
the romance of the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" continues to this day.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yours truly is glad I could serve
as a bridge to Yayoi.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Being able to meet everyone here...
...I'm so glad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can hear their prayers.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Please...! <chrname>...!
Hang in there, hang in there...! Give it everything...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —There was a feeling that had lingered in my heart all this time.

text_block_list.name: Man Looking at Phone
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare lose here...!
I'm definitely gonna watch you win...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —No matter how many times I lose, no matter how impossible they say it is.

text_block_list.name: Woman on a Date
text_block_list.text:
You can do it...!
If it's <chrname>, the title of world's best is――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —There was an ideal I kept yearning for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
...Seize the summit with your own hands.
You already have the power to do so, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I have continued entrusting hope to a future called "someday."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
What lies "beyond" this path is something
only you can forge. Run, sprint. Show me—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Our dreams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A single, pure emotion.
A heart that yearns to be 'number one in the world.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The romance that had driven us up to this day—was right here.

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "...Master, I will surpass you."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"‘The only one who can surpass Montjeu,
who changed European history...
is me, Venus Park.’"

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: "Ah, come here. My beloved children."

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text:
""...My, will you accept
my love as well?""

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha. In your case,
I must be the one to gift you love."

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: “Now then, Longchamp—”

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
"Bear witness!
To this moment where renowned Umamusume gathered from across the globe clash for the ultimate crown!"

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: "And bestow your blessings. ——Upon the Umamusume destined to bear the title of the world's strongest!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: “And so, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe begins once again this year—”
